query:
SELECT 
  r.id as residentId,
  r.firstName,
  r.lastName,
  p.id as packageId,
  p.packageType,
  p.totalHours,
  p.usedHours,
  p.deductedMinutes,
  p.isActive,
  p.startDate,
  p.endDate,
  (SELECT SUM(durationMinutes) FROM attendances WHERE packageId = p.id) as actualUsedMinutes
FROM residents r
LEFT JOIN packages p ON r.id = p.residentId
WHERE r.firstName = 'enka' AND r.lastName = 'enka'
ORDER BY p.endDate DESC;
